content.text:
**Finding submitted: compliant (at fallback).**

| Item | Document position | Checklist result |
|---|---|---|
| Governing law | § 26 (p0093) — California, conflicts-of-law excluded | Fallback element 1 met |
| Dispute forum | § 27 (p0094) — exclusive California state/federal courts, San Luis Obispo County | Fallback element 2 met |
| Arbitration seat | None anywhere in document | No walk-away trigger |

The bargain lands squarely on the fallback (California law + corresponding California courts), so no redline was proposed and none was validated. I noted in the rationale — rather than flagging as deviations — that (i) the venue county is TrueLink's own address, though both parties are California-based so we suffer no real forum burden, and (ii) §§ 18, 23 and 28 carry consequential California-statute references that would need conforming edits only if the choice of law were ever renegotiated toward the preferred New York position.
